items.title: Norris Turney interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: And I worked with Jeter I guess about a year.

ctx.x: Very good. Excellent. And I worked with Jeter I guess about a year. And then I left him and went to join Tiny Bradshaw. And after Tiny Bradshaw I joined Billy Eckstine’s band. And that was the end of my road work for a while, I went back home.
What was life like on the road in those days? Was it mostly bus travel first of all?
